study_design.primary_estimand: mean within-participant difference in fixation duration, pseudoword minus meaningful
study_design.primary_hypothesis: mean paired duration difference equals zero
study_design.group_role: reader group is an observed status used for heterogeneity, not a randomized treatment

counterbalancing.interpretation: Order imbalance or order-by-condition differences are treated as carryover sensitivity, not discarded.

design_sensitivity.assumptions: Normal approximation for paired mean, alpha 0.05, 80% power; reported as design sensitivity rather than a retrospective power claim.
design_sensitivity.spillover: No network or classroom identifiers are available; interference cannot be tested and is a limitation.
design_sensitivity.noncompliance: Both passage measures are present for all primary-analysis participants; detailed protocol adherence is not observed.

claim_class: within-study behavioral contrast; no policy outcome

provenance.citation: Al Dahhan, N. Z. et al. (2019). Eye movements of dyslexic and average readers in meaningful and pseudoword passage reading. Harvard Dataverse, V1. https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/3YCB56
